instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Community health foundation running maternal and child health programs, vaccination campaigns, and nutrition interventions in underserved urban communities. Team of 60 community health workers and 12 program managers. Evaluating mobile-based patient tracking and automated appointment reminder systems for immunization schedule adherence. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers. Decision-making is fast and informal, but we lack the specialized expertise in-house to evaluate complex technology investments without external advisory support.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have not undertaken any systematic innovation or transformation programs. Our operational model has been largely unchanged for several years. While leadership acknowledges the need to modernize, we have not yet allocated resources, defined ownership, or committed to a timeline for any specific innovation initiative.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 7 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Systematic Market and Service Line Diversification Strategy
opportunities.rationale: The board mandate requires systematic exploration of new revenue streams (25% goal). This opportunity evolves from initial interest into a structured process for identifying, vetting, and piloting adjacent markets. Given the high competitive pressure in NGOs, defining clear entry criteria is critical.

first_actions: Establish an internal cross-functional steering committee (Program Mgrs, Leadership) to define market selection KPIs.
Conduct a thorough review of 3 existing product lines' latent capabilities that could serve as services for adjacent NGO sectors.
Map out potential strategic acquisition profiles based on limited geographical expansion or niche technology expertise.
resources_needed: Dedicated senior time (minimum 10 hours/week) from program leadership
External consultant specializing in social enterprise scaling and market entry analysis
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of a prioritized market assessment matrix identifying the top 3 actionable diversification pathways.
milestones: Pilot feasibility study for one adjacent service line (Q2)
Formal business case presentation to the board detailing revenue projections and resource requirements.

opportunities.title: Establishing a Lightweight Innovation Governance Framework
opportunities.rationale: The lack of dedicated R&D and the high operational load forces innovation into 'spare cycles.' This initiative aims to formalize how ideas are captured, prioritized, and assessed without creating significant administrative overhead. It addresses both culture inertia and time constraints.

first_actions: Develop a simple 'Idea Intake Form' and designate a single point of contact (Program Manager) for collection.
Implement quarterly 'Innovation Hour' sessions dedicated solely to low-stakes brainstorming, separate from operational planning.
Create a basic RICE scoring model (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort) for preliminary idea assessment.
execution_plan.success_metric: Submission of 5 vetted, scored ideas within the first quarter.
milestones: First quarterly Idea Hour completed and results shared (Month 2)
Selection and assignment of resources for one pilot idea (Month 3)

next_steps.action: Formalize and staff the internal Innovation Champion role to manage idea capture (opp_process_optimization).
Procure a brief external consultation workshop focusing on 'Value Chain Mapping for Nonprofits' to refine diversification targets.
Conduct a skills gap analysis between current staff roles and the technical requirements needed for mobile patient tracking systems.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized, dedicated R&D function leading to idea stagnation and burnout among generalist developers.
High reliance on single decision-making points (Owner alone), which creates organizational bottlenecks for scaling initiatives.
Inability to systematically allocate time/resources toward long-term strategic goals due to persistent operational demands.

improvements: Successful launch of the inventory digitalization project, moving beyond conceptualization into execution.
Increased digital maturity (from 1 to 2), indicating basic system adoption and data handling capabilities.
Formal acceptance of the diversification mandate by the board, providing clear strategic direction.
persistent_gaps: Significant talent gap in specialized technical evaluation expertise.
Structural barrier concerning time allocation, where urgent operational tasks continue to overshadow innovation efforts.
The core cultural issue of viewing 'innovation' as an optional add-on rather than a central operational mandate.
achieved_milestones: Securing initial investment and scope for the inventory digitalization project.
Defining clear strategic intent through the board's diversification mandate.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Shifted from defining *if* innovation is needed to defining *how* it will be executed. Progress has moved key projects into the active execution phase (digitalization), and strategic goals are quantified with a clear mandate for diversification.
